institution: Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences, Tirupati
citation: Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences. SVIMS Antimicrobial Stewardship Pocket Guide, 5th edition (Jul 2018 to Dec 2018), with Healthcare Associated Infections report. Tirupati: SVIMS; 2018.
reporting: Percent resistant by organism: Gram-negative bacilli with isolate numbers for all locations and for ICUs; S. aureus, CoNS and Enterococcus without isolate numbers; plus a chart of imipenem resistance by organism.

verification.note: Tables on pages 19 and 20 read from the rendered pages (scale 2.2) and compared cell by cell with the PDF text layer; the page 22 to 24 charts (data labels mapped to their axis categories by x position in the text layer and checked on the images) agree with the page 19 table except Enterobacter piperacillin-tazobactam; imipenem values from the page 26 chart were read from its printed data labels and checked on the image.

notes: Half-yearly SVIMS Antimicrobial Stewardship pocket guide (5th edition). Data period: the index dates the resistance section January to June 2018 and the HAI charts run only to July 2018, so the figures are treated as January to June 2018 although the cover and the census give July to December 2018 (end set to 2018-06). All figures are percent resistant (intermediate therefore counts as not resistant). "Nil" is recorded as 0. Column M is taken as meropenem (the text gives the same figures as meropenem susceptibility); Pseudomonas figures printed "(Imp)" are imipenem. Imipenem for the other organisms comes from the page 26 chart. Specimen base not stated: rows are recorded as all specimens. Downloaded from the Wayback copy https://web.archive.org/web/20220108030112id_/https://svimstpt.ap.nic.in/quality_files/feb2019/haidec2018.pdf (the live host resets connections).
issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: all 112 cells (the seeded sample of 40 plus every other cell) and all 12 row n values read from the page images (pages 19, 20 and 26, scale 2.5) before comparing with the extraction: 0 transcription errors, no value changed. The charts on pages 22 to 24 agree with the page 19 table except Enterobacter piperacillin-tazobactam (table 42, chart 39), so the recorded conflict is accurate. Column M as meropenem is supported by the page 27 text (meropenem sensitivity E. coli 89, Klebsiella 60, Acinetobacter 53%), and the page 26 imipenem labels (Klebsiella 43, E. coli 15, Pseudomonas 77, Acinetobacter 42, Enterobacter 29) equal the page 27 text.

Added two conflicts on the Acinetobacter all-locations row: the page 27 key messages give amikacin 67% and co-trimoxazole 54% resistant, against 49 and 67 in both the page 19 table and the page 23 chart; every other organism figure in the key messages agrees with the tables. Period confirmed: the index (page 15) dates the section January to June 2018 and the pocket guide cover (page 11) reads Jul 2018 to Dec 2018, 5th edition.

Population: the section is titled Trends of Multidrug Resistance, as in the 2020 and 2021 editions whose Gram-negative tables are MDR subsets, but these tables carry no MDR label and their isolate numbers (E. coli 1646 in six months) are far above the 2020 MDR set (E. coli 675); kept as a cumulative antibiogram.
